gaps: HMLR_MATCHER_CANDIDATE_ROW_SET_UNIQUENESS_GAP
The matcher checks only that the starter candidate list length is three; duplicate or shifted row numbers can still enter the states map and final matched count.
Require the exact unique row set 30762, 46142 and 61522 before opening any vector source.
HMLR_MATCHER_CANDIDATE_PARCEL_UNIQUENESS_GAP
Candidate parcel IDs are required to be non-empty but are not bound to parcel_<row> or required to be distinct.
Require the exact row-parcel tuple and a unique parcel ID set.
HMLR_MATCHER_CANDIDATE_HMLR_STATE_OVERWRITE_GAP
The states dictionary is keyed by cleaned HMLR ID; duplicate candidate IDs silently overwrite an earlier candidate before matching.
Reject duplicate normalized HMLR IDs before constructing the state dictionary.
HMLR_MATCHER_CANDIDATE_FINITE_BNG_RANGE_GAP
BNG easting and northing are converted with float() but are not required to be finite or within the British National Grid range.
Require finite coordinates within the approved BNG bounds and bind them to the starter source hash.
HMLR_MATCHER_STARTER_JSON_STRICTNESS_GAP
The starter manifest uses the default JSON decoder, which accepts non-standard NaN/Infinity and does not reject duplicate object names.
Use a strict duplicate-key and parse_constant rejecting decoder with a versioned schema.
HMLR_MATCHER_MAX_FILES_ARGUMENT_RANGE_GAP
--max-files is not required to be positive or contract-bounded.
Reject non-positive, overflow and above-contract values before filesystem enumeration.
HMLR_MATCHER_EXPLICIT_VECTOR_COUNT_BYPASS_GAP
Explicit --vector files are appended without applying max_files; the limit is checked only while walking vector roots.
Apply one aggregate file-count ceiling across explicit and discovered sources.
HMLR_MATCHER_VECTOR_ENUMERATION_PRELIMIT_GAP
sorted(root.rglob('*')) materializes the complete tree before the max_files check, allowing unbounded path enumeration work.
Use a bounded iterator with path-count, depth, elapsed-time and aggregate-stat ceilings.
HMLR_MATCHER_VECTOR_FINAL_PATH_CONTAINMENT_GAP
Resolved vector paths are not proven to remain under an authorized extraction root and can follow symlinks or reparse points outside it.
Open sources under the approved root and verify final-handle containment and volume identity.
HMLR_MATCHER_VECTOR_TOTAL_BYTES_GAP
No per-file or aggregate source-byte limit is applied before Fiona/GDAL opens vector datasets.
Enforce bounded file and aggregate bytes before parsing and record accepted sizes.
HMLR_MATCHER_EXPLICIT_SUFFIX_DRIVER_GAP
Explicit vector files bypass the suffix filter and can invoke any GDAL-recognized datasource.
Require the exact GML/XML input policy and reject unexpected suffixes or container formats.
HMLR_MATCHER_DRIVER_ALLOWLIST_GAP
fiona.open does not require a pinned driver and records no driver identity, so an unintended installed GDAL driver may parse the file.
Allow only the expected GML/GMLAS driver policy and receipt the effective driver/version/options.
HMLR_MATCHER_LAYER_COUNT_NAME_SCHEMA_GAP
All reported layers are opened without a bounded layer count or an expected HMLR application-layer name/schema.
Require an exact or approved layer schema and bounded unique layer names.
HMLR_MATCHER_FEATURE_COUNT_RUNTIME_GAP
Feature iteration has no per-layer, per-file, total-feature or elapsed-time ceiling.
Apply explicit resource ceilings and publish counts even on a fail-closed stop.
HMLR_MATCHER_GML_SCHEMA_BINDING_GAP
The generic GDAL GML reader can infer feature classes when an XSD is absent; the matcher does not require the HMLR INSPIRE application schema or namespace.
Bind the expected GML namespace, schema location/version and feature type before matching.
HMLR_MATCHER_GML_IDENTIFIER_FIELD_EXACT_GAP
Identifier discovery accepts feature id and any property whose name resembles id, cadastral or identifier instead of one exact Land Registry-INSPIRE ID field.
Require the documented exact identifier field/namespace and reject aliases or multiple candidate identifier fields.
HMLR_MATCHER_IDENTIFIER_SCALAR_TYPE_GAP
Identifier values of arbitrary types are stringified; lists, mappings or complex objects can become accidental normalized matches.
Require one scalar string identifier with a bounded canonical syntax.
HMLR_MATCHER_XML_NETWORK_ENTITY_POLICY_GAP
The Fiona/GDAL XML parser configuration is not pinned or receipted for external schema, XLink, entity and network access.
Disable unapproved network/entity resolution and bind every permitted local schema resource by hash.
HMLR_MATCHER_TRANSFORMER_BALLPARK_ACCURACY_GAP
When a source CRS differs, Transformer.from_crs uses default operation selection without allow_ballpark=False, only_best, accuracy or area-of-use checks.
Require native EPSG:27700 or a pinned non-ballpark transformation with known accuracy and matching area of use.
HMLR_MATCHER_GEOMETRY_FINITE_BOUNDED_AREA_GAP
Geometry acceptance checks validity/type/emptiness but not finite coordinates, positive finite area, expected GB bounds or plausible area ceilings.
Validate coordinates, bounds and area before and after any repair.
HMLR_MATCHER_SOURCE_HASH_TOCTOU_GAP
Features are read first and the source path is reopened later for size and SHA256, so the receipt may describe bytes different from those parsed.
Hash and parse an immutable handle or verify stable file identity before and after both operations.
HMLR_MATCHER_OUTPUT_GEOMETRY_RESOURCE_GAP
Full WKT and GeoJSON geometry are embedded for every match without vertex, nesting or receipt-size ceilings.
Apply bounded geometry complexity and store a hash plus a separately bounded canonical geometry artifact.
HMLR_MATCHER_OUTPUT_RECEIPT_ATOMICITY_GAP
The final matcher receipt is written directly with write_text and has no generation nonce, flush, atomic replace or remote child-manifest binding.
Publish strict generation-bound JSON through same-volume temporary write, flush, atomic replace and remote readback.
HMLR_MATCHER_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_GENERATION_GAP
Matched vector paths and hashes are not bound to the HMLR download/extraction receipt, authority archive hash, task, attempt, continuation and generation.
Require one generation manifest linking catalogue response, authority ZIP, extracted GML and matcher output hashes.
